verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference and training platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it versions and rolls back workflows or agents built on it. The evidence shows nothing for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: the model deprecation and redirect policy, fine-tuning jobs, and function-calling agent loops that users build in their own application code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
